claims: The Chainsmokers performed a halftime concert between the 2026 NCAA Men’s Final Four games at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis on April 4, 2026.
The performance was part of the "Madness After Dark" event.
The performance caused the second semifinal game to be delayed.
The performance drew criticism from fans and media members.
Critics, including Dave Portnoy and Scott Van Pelt, questioned the decision to host a full concert in the middle of basketball games.
The second game started around 9:30 p.m. ET.
The act took place between the first game (UConn vs. Illinois) and the second game (Michigan vs. Arizona).
